done_when: When close keeps the default branch's forge.toml, its line says the change is kept out because the item's Done-when does not name forge.toml and gives the forge fix amend step to allow it

known.title: Data loss: Expose the recovery step before land merges
Functional: Reapply the setting before handing recovery to a worker
Functional: Put the task allowance in the checkout that work reads

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Data loss (floor: data loss)
Case: normal use - an agent runs `forge land` on a fix that includes an unlisted settings change.
Close prints the recovery advice, but `src/forge/land.py:91-93` calls close synchronously and `src/forge/land.py:146-152` then merges when agent merging is enabled. `src/forge/merge.py:198` squash-merges the restored settings, and lines 283-316 remove the remote branch, clean worktree, and local branch. The caller cannot act on the advice before the intended settings change is omitted from the merge and the item is cleaned up.
Adds work: signal the settings restore to land and pause before merging; F 1 x H 1 = 1; 2 x C = 4
findings.title: Data loss: Expose the recovery step before land merges

why: Close silently puts back the default branch's forge.toml when a fix changes it, and the line it prints does not say how to allow the change, so a client agent lost its settings change in an upgrade fix
